PendingApproval.title: Registration under review
PendingApproval.description: Your email is confirmed and your request reached the OCA team. Once they review the intended use you described, you will get an email and be able to access the platform.
PendingApproval.revokedDescription: The OCA team removed your access to the platform. If you think this was a mistake, or if you want to delete your account, contact the team.
PendingApproval.withdrawSummary: Deletes your login and your registration data. This cannot be undone.
PendingApproval.withdrawExplain: We delete your login, your password, and the email and intended use you sent when registering. To use the platform later, you will need to register again. To confirm, enter your email and password.
PendingApproval.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
PendingApproval.failed: We could not delete it right now. Try again later.
PendingApproval.askTeam: This registration is not awaiting approval. If you already have access, delete the account under "My account" on the platform. Otherwise, contact the team.
PendingApproval.doneBody: Your login and your registration data were deleted.
